justifications.r1: 4-color mana fixing with green ramp and artifacts.
justifications.r2: Proliferating loyalty on planeswalkers generates compounding card advantage every turn.
justifications.a1: Planeswalker tutors and high superfriends redundancy.
justifications.a2: Deploys Atraxa and establishes planeswalker board presence on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents game-winning planeswalker ultimate locks on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to tick loyalty to emblem thresholds.
justifications.p3: Planeswalkers on board clearly display loyalty counts.
justifications.i2: Narset, Parter of Veils shuts down opposing card draw.
justifications.s1: Teferi's Protection and Atraxa vigilance/lifelink body deter attacks.
justifications.s2: Moderate recovery via mass reanimation (Primevals' Glorious Rebirth).
justifications.s3: Planeswalkers tick up independently, but Atraxa doubles the clock.
